description: This file contains test cases using pytest for the litellm library, specifically testing the conversion of chat responses to text completions, handling of logprobs, and streaming behavior in the context of the litellm package.

classes.name: ModelResponse
classes.description: Represents a hypothetical model response object with attributes such as id, created timestamp, model name, choices, usage, and hidden params.

classes.name: TextCompletionResponse
classes.description: Represents the text completion response with attributes like id, object type, created timestamp, choices, and usage.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: Encapsulates token usage details including total, prompt, and completion tokens, with optional detailed breakdowns.

methods.name: test_convert_chat_to_text_completion()
methods.description: Tests the conversion of a chat model response to a text completion response, verifying attributes and choices.

methods.name: test_convert_provider_response_logprobs_non_huggingface()
methods.description: Tests logprobs conversion function when the provider is not Huggingface, expecting a None result.

methods.name: test_convert_chat_to_text_completion_multiple_choices()
methods.description: Verifies conversion behavior when multiple choices are present in chat response.

methods.name: test_text_completion_include_usage(sync_mode)
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the text completion stream with include_usage option for both sync and async modes.
